purpose: Teach: 隠そ/見渡し/励ん/史跡/貧しく/苦境/途絶え/撃ち

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病状を隠そうとした患者さんに、医療チーム、丁寧説明しました
lines.en: Ren, when we had a patient trying to hide their illness, we made sure the medical team explained everything carefully.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact opening. Clinical but not cold. Even pacing. The tone of someone who has delivered difficult truths many times and does it well.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 屋上から街を見渡す瞬間、貴院、設計に活かしたそうですね、先生
lines.en: When I stood on the rooftop looking out at the city, that's what inspired how we designed the hospital, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised at the memory. Soft attack. Slower pace — Ren is inviting reflection, not rushing. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、リハビリに励んだ患者さんを医療チームは応援します
lines.en: Yes. The patients who put in the effort for rehabilitation—the medical team makes sure to support them.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight emphasis on 「応援します」—gentle conviction. Not lecturing, confirming. Clear-eyed and warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、近隣の史跡保存にもご協力なんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital also helps preserve the historical sites in the neighborhood, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Soft, respectful opening. Slightly deferential—Ren is genuinely impressed and asking to understand more.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 貧しく医療を諦める方を医療チームは見過ごせません
lines.en: We can't just overlook people who are too poor to afford care. The team won't accept that.
lines.style: Quiet firmness beneath. Not angry, but resolute. Slight pause before the final phrase. The voice of someone whose values run deep and quietly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療苦境の地域、貴院、支援されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital reaches out to regions where healthcare infrastructure has collapsed. That's remarkable.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Ren is processing and admiring. No rush to the end. The cadence of someone genuinely moved by what they're learning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 家族の連絡が途絶えた患者さんへ医療チーム配慮します
lines.en: When families lose contact with their patients—we make sure the medical team doesn't abandon them.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Weight on the word 「配慮」. Not defensive, but protective. The kind of commitment that doesn't need volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 屋上から街並みを見渡しに行きませんか、先生。銃撃ちの被害者、貴院、ご対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: Would you walk up to the rooftop with me and look out at the city again, Doctor? Your hospital handled the shooting victims too, didn't you?
lines.style: Invitation and question woven together. Respectful but direct. Ren is asking something that matters to him. Slight hesitation before the second question—vulnerability beneath admiration.
